slug: 2025-10-17 Algeria launches Dzair Services single-window public-services platform

facts.fact: The note says the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 was unveiled in May 2025 with seven pillars including digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and technological sovereignty; no adopting act is named.
The note gives the strategy the period 2025-2030; it does not say the text is public (as-at 2025-10-17).

systems.platform: interoperability system for automatic verified-data exchange
systems.tiers: single access point for national public digital services; 46 ministries and agencies connected to fibre
